Clay enrichments integration overview

# Clay enrichments integration overview

AI-powered data enrichment for improved outreach and sales automation.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/687563213dfbc91a782122b1/691d4e5421aa15e276c6ab37_Web%20Scraping.avif)

Overview

## Clay Enrichments Overview

### `Action` Find Mobile Number & Social URLs using a social URL or personal email as input.

To run Clay Enrichments:

**Step 1:** Enter a social URL or email address.

**Step 2:** Configure run settings.

By default, new rows within your Clay table will automatically run this enrichment. Learn more about auto-update in [this brief guide](https://docs.clay.com/en/articles/9642165-auto-update-and-auto-dedupe-table).

To run enrichment only under specific conditions, use formulas that trigger the column when the formula is true. Learn more about AI formulas in [this Clay University lesson](https://www.clay.com/university/lesson/ai-formulas-conditional-runs-clay-101).

**Step 3:** Run your enrichment to find mobile number and social URL of your contact.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/687e604972375496b891fe58/691e659672799829db4d6a1a_6740c22fe9caaca34a723649_6740c1fdf4d474b849828109_CleanShot%2525202024-11-20%252520at%25252021.15.30%2525402x.png)
